svg.title: No school record in the next two years
svg.desc: No school record in the next two years. Modern definition. Adjusted descriptive difference (pp): no school record in the next two years. Not school dropout. Nominal uncertainty intervals: annual 95%; pooled 98.75%. 2016: +2.0 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2017: +0.2 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2018: +1.1 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2019: +1.2 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2020: −0.5 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2021: +1.2 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2022: +3.1 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; 2023: −1.1 pp; WEAK_CLUSTER_PRECISION; pooled: +1.1 pp; SCHOOL_CLUSTER_CI. Period-specific scale; do not compare lengths across panels. † Weak precision or no valid interval.
